Ignore any text reporting the OP's view change, delta awards, thank-you or resolution updates, or whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not outcome reporting. List order carries no meaning. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_abstract_reasoning: Read OC_comments, a JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP. Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment employs abstract reasoning, i.e. argues through general principles, logical or conceptual argument, or generalized claims, not by recounting a concrete personal experience. A comment may also contain an anecdote; it still counts if it also uses abstract reasoning. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty and no comment does so. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Ignore any text reporting the OP's view change, delta awards, thank-you or resolution updates, or whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not outcome reporting. List order carries no meaning. (dtype: binary)

oc_comment_count: Parse OC_comments with json.loads. If missing or malformed (not a list), return null. Otherwise return len(list) (0 for a valid empty list). Counts list entries (comments), not distinct commenters; no text content or outcome information is used. (dtype: numeric)
has_at_least_three_oc_comments: Using `oc_comment_count`: return null if df['oc_comment_count'] is null, 1 if df['oc_comment_count'] >= 3, else 0. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_direct_counterargument: Read title, argument and OC_comments (a JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment directly counterargues the OP's view: it explicitly presents reasoning, evidence or examples against the OP's main view (title/argument) or a specific OP claim. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does so (e.g., only agreement, clarifying questions, off-topic remarks, jokes, moderator/bot notices, or tangents that do not argue against the OP's view). An empty valid list returns 0. If OC_comments is missing or malformed, or OP title and argument are both missing so the target view cannot be identified, return null. Quoted material counts only when the commenter uses it to argue against the OP. Do not use any OP view-change or delta-award announcement, post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred as evidence, even if inside argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained. Use current supplied text; do not infer timing or initial snapshots. Output a single 0/1 or null. (dtype: binary)

op_argument_epistemic_certainty: Read only the OP's argument field (current supplied text, including marked edits). Score the OP's own assertions about their view on a 0-10 integer scale of epistemic certainty conveyed by modality markers. Anchors: 0 = nearly all claims are explicitly modest or uncertain (e.g. 'I think', 'maybe', 'might', 'I could be wrong', 'not sure'); 5 = a roughly even mix of hedged and unhedged claims; 10 = nearly all claims are stated with high-modality/categorical certainty (e.g. 'obviously', 'definitely', 'must', 'always', 'never', 'undeniably') and no hedging. Assumption: aggregate over the whole argument by the overall balance of hedged versus high-certainty markers on the claims central to the OP's position; this aggregation is an operational choice, not a hypothesis requirement. Exclude quotations of other people or reported opponents' positions unless the OP adopts them, and exclude moderator/bot notices. Exclude and ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if they contain hedged or certain wording; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial version by removing edits. If the argument is missing, malformed, or contains no assessable OP assertions after exclusions, return null. (dtype: numeric)

op_argument_tone_policing_request: Read only the OP's argument text (current text, including marked edits). Return 1 if the OP in their own voice explicitly requests or demands that responders/readers change the tone or manner of their replies (e.g. be calm, civil, polite, less angry/emotional/aggressive), i.e. an explicit tone-policing request. Return 0 if the argument is present and has no such explicit request. Do not count mere description of the OP's own tone, general topic discussion of civility, requests to be open-minded or give evidence, or quoted/reported requests by others not adopted by the OP. Do not count generic subreddit rule mentions unless the OP directly asks commenters to change tone. Exclude and ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. If argument is missing or malformed return null. Output 0 or 1. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_redrafts_op_view_before_refuting: Read title, argument (OP's view; needed to identify the target) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP). Return 1 if at least one single comment first redrafts the OP's viewpoint, i.e. rewrites or reframes the OP's position from a more nuanced perspective (e.g. a refined, qualified or charitably reformulated version of the OP's claim), and then refutes or argues against that redrafted/OP view in the same comment. Merely quoting, summarizing without nuance, agreeing, or refuting without first restating the view gives no credit; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if OP title and argument are both missing such that the OP's view cannot be identified. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, wherever they appear (including argument); do not use them as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained. Use current supplied text; no timing is inferred. (dtype: binary)

post_score_above_50: Using the numeric column post_score: return null if post_score is missing or non-numeric; return 1 if float(post_score) > 50 (strictly greater), else 0. Reads only post_score; no text is used. (dtype: binary)

op_argument_explicit_uncertainty: Read only the OP's argument text (current supplied text, including marked edits). Return 1 if the OP, in their own voice, uses at least one explicit marker of uncertainty about their own claims or view (e.g., 'I might be wrong', 'I'm not sure', 'maybe', 'possibly', 'to my knowledge', 'I think' used as a hedge, stated doubt). Return 0 if the argument is assessable and has no such marker. Do not count uncertainty in quoted external text or attributed to others, rhetorical questions that are not expressions of the OP's own doubt, or moderator/bot notices. Exclude and ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed (even inside argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered. Do not attempt to reconstruct an initial version; do not remove edits except for outcome-reporting text. If argument is missing or malformed, return null. (dtype: binary)

op_argument_acknowledges_counterargument_or_limitation: Read only the argument column (the OP's own text, current supplied version including any marked edits). Return 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly acknowledges a counter-argument to their view or a limitation/weakness/exception of their own position (e.g. 'a counterpoint is...', 'I admit this may not hold when...', 'one weakness of my view is...'). Illustrative phrasings are not exhaustive. Return 0 if no such explicit acknowledgment is present. Do not count merely hedging language without naming a counter-argument or limitation, quoted text from other users or opposing positions the OP does not adopt, or moderator/bot notices. Exclude and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the view changed (including in edits); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered if relevant. Do not attempt to reconstruct an initial snapshot by removing edits. If argument is missing or malformed, return null. Output a single value: 1, 0, or null. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_named_real_world_analogy: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment uses a named, real-world analogy or example (a specific identifiable historical, scientific, institutional or other actual case, person, event or phenomenon, used to analogize to or illustrate the argument against the OP). Examples are nonexhaustive; no outside verification needed. Invented/hypothetical scenarios and generic unnamed appeals do not count. Quotation of a case counts if the comment uses it as its analogy/example. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither positive evidence nor an outcome announcement. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies; return 0 for a valid empty list; return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Output a single 0/1 or null. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_abstract_logical_rebuttal: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment rebuts the OP through abstract logical reasoning (general principles, definitions, logical structure, inference critique) without relying on a named real-world analogy or specific case. A comment that relies on a named real-world analogy or example does not count. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies; return 0 for a valid empty list; return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Output a single 0/1 or null. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_contrasts_op_view_with_relatable_personal_experience: Read title, argument (for OP view context) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly contrasts the OP's stated view with a relatable real-world personal experience, i.e. a specific actual lived experience (the commenter's own or that of someone they personally describe), presented as differing from or counter to the OP's view. Hypothetical or invented scenarios, purely abstract/statistical/institutional arguments, and generic mentions of experience without a contrast to the OP's view do not count; the experience and the contrast must be in the same comment. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including inside argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible but is not itself an experience. Quotations of others' experience count only if the commenter adopts them as relevant to the contrast. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if OP context is missing so the contrast cannot be assessed. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

title_has_emotional_or_personal_identifier: Read only the title (the OP's heading). Return 1 if the title explicitly contains an emotional identifier (a stated emotion or feeling, e.g. words naming feelings such as angry, hate, afraid, love, sad) or a personal identifier (explicit first-person reference to the OP's own identity, traits, circumstances or experience, e.g. 'I am a ...', 'my ...', 'as a ...'). Both must be explicit in the title wording; do not infer from the topic or tone alone. The standard 'CMV:' prefix is not itself an identifier. Return 0 if the title has no such explicit emotional or personal identifier. Exclude any text in the title that announces a view change, delta award, thank-you/resolution update or otherwise reports the outcome; such text is not evidence. Generic mentions of platform/delta rules are not outcome announcements. If the title is missing or empty, return null. Output a single value: 1, 0, or null. (dtype: binary)

has_multi_turn_reply_interaction: Read only the conversation column, a text of turns formatted as '[speaker]: message' separated by blank lines. Return 1 if it contains a multi-turn reply interaction: a back-and-forth exchange of at least three consecutive turns in which the same speaker label speaks again after at least one other speaker's turn (e.g. A, B, A), with the later turn plausibly replying within the exchange. Return 0 if the conversation contains only single turns, only turns from distinct speakers with no speaker returning, or only one-off comments with no returning speaker. Do not treat bracketed text inside a message body as a turn label unless it begins a new turn in the format. Do not infer who the OP is. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; turns consisting solely of such content do not count as interaction turns, though generic discussion of delta/platform rules does count normally. Do not count turn content only because it is an announcement. If conversation is missing, empty or malformed such that turns cannot be identified, return null. Output a single value: 1 or 0 (or null). (dtype: binary)

exactly_one_oc_comment: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list. If missing or malformed return null. Otherwise return 1 if len(list)==1, else 0 (an empty list gives 0). Counts comments only; it does not measure comment ratings, and no text is read, so outcome-reporting content (OP view-change/delta announcements, thank-you updates) plays no role. (dtype: binary)

op_argument_self_referential_platform_or_status_meta: Read only the OP's argument text (current text, including marked edits). Return 1 if the OP's own text contains explicit self-referential meta-commentary about platform mechanics (e.g., subreddit rules, posting/moderation, karma/votes, how the platform or delta system works, formatting/edits as platform features) or about the author's own status (e.g., the author's account, newness, credentials, standing or identity on the platform). The commentary must be explicit and refer to the OP themself or their post in relation to the platform/status. Generic discussion of platform/delta rules by the OP retains eligibility if it is self-referential. EXCLUDE the OP's view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (e.g., 'Edit: my view was changed', 'delta awarded'); these never count as evidence even if they contain meta-commentary. Quoted text from other people does not count unless the OP adopts it as their own. Return 0 if the argument is present and has no such commentary. Return null if argument is missing or malformed. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot; do not use other columns. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_quotes_op_argument: Read OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments; parse it) and the OP's argument (use title only to interpret context). Return 1 if at least one comment directly quotes wording from the OP's argument text (verbatim or near-verbatim quoted/block-quoted passage that matches the argument), regardless of whether the commenter agrees, disagrees or refutes. Paraphrase without quoted wording, quotes of other comments or external sources, and quoting only the title do not count. Return 0 if the comment list is valid and no comment quotes the argument. If OC_comments is a valid empty list return 0. If OC_comments or argument is missing or malformed return null. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if within the argument or a comment; quoted text consisting of such content does not count. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Use supplied current text, including marked edits; list order carries no meaning. Output a single 0/1 or null. (dtype: binary)

post_score_below_median: Using the supplied numeric column post_score: m = df['post_score'].median() computed over all rows of the analyzed corpus; return 1 if df['post_score'] < m, 0 if df['post_score'] >= m, and null if post_score is missing or non-numeric. Rows equal to the median count as not below. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_second_person_address_to_op: Read only OC_comments, a JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP. Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment directly addresses the OP in the second person (e.g., 'you', 'your', 'you're' referring to the OP as the person being addressed, such as 'your view', 'you say', 'you should consider'). Return 0 if comments are assessable and none contain such direct address to the OP. Do not count generic/impersonal 'you' (meaning 'one' or people in general), 'you' inside quoted text from third parties or addressed to someone other than the OP, or 'you' in quoted OP text unless the commenter themself addresses the OP. Exclude moderator/bot notices, and exclude any text that is an OP view-change/delta-award announcement, post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Empty valid list: return 0. Missing or malformed OC_comments: return null. Output a single 0/1 value per row. List order carries no meaning. (dtype: binary)

op_argument_direct_plea_nonviolence: Read only the argument column (the OP's own text; current text including marked edits). Return 1 if the OP, in their own voice, makes a direct plea, urging or explicit appeal for non-violence (e.g., asking that people refrain from, avoid, renounce or not resort to violence). Return 0 if no such direct plea is present, including when violence is merely discussed, described, analyzed, or argued for/against without an explicit appeal for nonviolence. Do not count quoted or reported views of others unless the OP explicitly adopts them as their own plea. Exclude and ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; do not use them as evidence even if they express the construct. Generic discussion of platform/delta rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained if relevant. If argument is missing or malformed, return null. Output a single value: 1, 0, or null. (dtype: binary)

argument_has_first_person_singular_pronoun: Read only the argument column (the OP's current supplied text, including marked edits). Return 1 if the argument contains at least one explicit first-person singular pronoun (I, me, my, mine, myself, including contractions like I'm, I've, I'd, I'll) in the OP's own voice; return 0 if, after the exclusions, none occur. Exclusions: ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the OP's view changed or the outcome occurred (e.g. 'my view was changed', 'Δ awarded', 'thanks, you changed my mind'); pronouns appearing only in such text do not count. Generic discussion of platform/delta rules is retained and may count if it contains such a pronoun in the OP's voice. Also ignore first-person pronouns that occur only inside quotations of other people's words not adopted by the OP, and moderator/bot notices. Do not infer an initial snapshot or remove edits otherwise. Missing or malformed argument returns null; an empty-string argument returns 0. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_presents_counterargument: Read title, argument and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Title and argument give the OP's view, needed to identify the target. Return 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments presents a counterargument, i.e. a reason, evidence or reasoning offered against the OP's stated view or its supporting claims; agreement-only, pure questions without argumentative challenge, jokes, moderator/bot notices and off-topic remarks do not count. Partial counterarguments count; the comment need not be correct or persuasive. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies. If OC_comments is empty (valid empty list) return 0. If OC_comments is missing/malformed, or the OP title/argument needed to identify the target is missing, return null. Ignore and never use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained. Do not use conversation or any outcome column. Output a single 0/1 or null. (dtype: binary)

counterargument_cognitive_complexity: Read only OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP). Parse the list. If missing/malformed return null; if a valid list is empty return null. Rate the cognitive complexity of the counterarguments' own reasoning on an integer 0-10 scale: differentiation (recognizing multiple perspectives, distinctions, conditions, trade-offs) and integration (relating those perspectives into a reasoned synthesis or qualified conclusion). Anchors: 0 = no reasoning; 2 = single simple assertion, one-sided with no qualification; 4 = some reasons but little differentiation; 6 = several distinct considerations or acknowledgment of alternative views/conditions; 8 = clear differentiation plus integration of perspectives, with qualifications; 10 = highly differentiated, integrated, nuanced multi-perspective reasoning. Row aggregation assumption: judge the comments jointly and give one score reflecting the overall complexity of the counterarguments, rather than a mean or max; this assumption is operational. Do not score quoted text from others as the commenter's own reasoning unless adopted. Ignore and exclude any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules may be considered. Output one number 0-10 or null. (dtype: numeric)

any_comment_acknowledges_op_valid_point_before_discrepancy: Read title, argument (OP's view, for identifying the target) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP; parse it; list order is not chronology or rank). Return 1 if at least one single comment first explicitly acknowledges that the OP has a valid/reasonable/partly correct underlying point (e.g. concedes something in the OP's view is right) and then, later in the same comment, introduces a discrepancy, counterpoint or disagreement with the OP's view. The acknowledgment must be explicit and about the OP's position, not mere politeness, thanks or restating it, and must precede the discrepancy; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does this (including comments that are pure refutations, agreement only, or acknowledge only after the objection). Return null if OC_comments is empty, missing or malformed, or if OP title/argument is missing so the target cannot be determined. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if inside argument or comments; do not use them as evidence. Generic discussion of delta or platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered. Use current supplied text; do not reconstruct initial text. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_names_specific_external_program_or_location: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment itself references a specific, named external program (e.g., a named policy, initiative, scheme, service, or organized program) or a specific, named location (e.g., a named country, city, region, or place) as part of its argument. Generic or unnamed references (e.g., 'some programs', 'a country', 'a city') do not count. The reference need not be endorsed or verified. Ignore any text that is an OP view-change/delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and is eligible only if it otherwise meets the construct. Return 0 if the list is valid and empty or no comment qualifies. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. List order carries no meaning. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

all_comments_only_abstract_logical_refutation: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it). Return 1 if every comment argues solely through abstract logical refutation (general reasoning, principles, definitions, logical structure) and no comment references any specific, named external program or location. Return 0 if at least one comment references a specific, named external program or location, or relies on any non-abstract content such as concrete examples, anecdotes, or data. Ignore any text that is an OP view-change/delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. Return null if the list is empty, missing or malformed (no comment to assess). List order carries no meaning. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_quotes_and_refutes_op_phrase: Read the OP's title and argument (OP context) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one single comment both (a) explicitly quotes or verbatim reproduces a specific phrase/wording from the OP's title or argument (quotation marks or blockquote; must match available OP text) and (b) argues against or refutes that same quoted phrase in the same comment. Endorsing-only quotes, paraphrases without quoted wording, and quote and refutation split across separate comments do not qualify. Return 0 if the comment list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list (0). Return null if OC_comments, title or argument is missing or malformed so that the measurement cannot be determined (a positive match observed in available text may still return 1). Ignore as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, including within the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Measure current supplied text; do not infer initial snapshots or comment order. Output a single 0/1. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_refutes_op_specific_example: Read the OP title and argument (for identifying the OP's specific examples/anecdotes) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly refutes (argues against, contradicts or debunks) a specific example or anecdote that the OP provided, judged within that single comment. Return 0 if no comment does so (e.g., comments only address the general premise, or only agree/mention an example without refuting it). Empty valid comment list -> 0. Missing/malformed OC_comments, or missing OP text needed to identify OP examples -> null. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement. Comment order is not meaningful. Use current supplied text; do not infer initial snapshots. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_addresses_op_main_premise_directly: Read the OP title and argument (to identify the OP's main premise/central claim) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment directly argues about the OP's main premise or central claim itself, rather than targeting a specific OP example or anecdote. Return 0 if no comment does. Empty valid comment list -> 0. Missing/malformed OC_comments or missing OP text needed to identify the premise -> null. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement. Comment order is not meaningful. Use current supplied text; do not infer initial snapshots. (dtype: binary)

argument_has_hedging_language: Read only the OP's argument column. Return 1 if the OP's own assertions in the argument include at least one hedging or qualifying expression that softens, limits or conditions the strength or scope of a claim (e.g., 'might', 'perhaps', 'I think', 'to my knowledge', 'in some cases', 'generally'); return 0 if the argument is assessable and has none. Ignore quoted text from others, quoted opponents' positions and moderator/bot notices unless the OP adopts them. Use the current supplied text including marked edits, but exclude any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the view changed; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. If argument is missing or malformed return null. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

argument_has_absolute_declarative_statements: Read only the OP's argument column. Return 1 if the OP's own assertions include at least one absolute declarative statement: a claim stated categorically and unconditionally, with no hedge or qualifier (e.g., 'always', 'never', 'all', 'obviously', flat assertions of fact). Return 0 if the argument is assessable and has none. Ignore quoted text from others, quoted opponents' positions and moderator/bot notices unless the OP adopts them. Use the current supplied text including marked edits, but exclude any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the view changed; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. If argument is missing or malformed return null. This is independent of hedging: an argument may have both. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_quotes_op_text: Read title, argument (OP's text) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes wording from the OP's title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim, e.g. in quotation marks or markdown blockquote, matching available OP text); the comment need not agree with or refute the quote. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty and no comment contains such a quote (paraphrase, summary or topic mention alone does not count; quoting other users, external sources, or non-OP text does not count). Return 0 for a valid empty comment list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title/argument is missing so that a negative cannot be established (a clear positive match to the available OP text still yields 1). Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, including within argument or quoted in comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and may be used. Use current supplied text; do not infer initial snapshots or chronology; comment order carries no meaning. Output one 0/1 value or null per row. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_validates_op_emotion_before_rebuttal: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), with title and argument as context for the OP's stated emotional experience. Return 1 if at least one single comment explicitly acknowledges or validates the OP's emotional experience (e.g., says their feelings are understandable, valid or legitimate) and this validation appears before that same comment's logical rebuttal/counter-argument to the OP's view. Validation and rebuttal must both be in the same comment; separate comments cannot satisfy it. Return 0 if comments exist but none does so (including validation only after rebuttal, no rebuttal, or validation of non-emotional matters such as mere agreement with facts). Empty comment list: 0. Missing or malformed OC_comments: null. Ignore quotations of other people's positions not adopted by the commenter, and moderator/bot notices. Exclude from evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even in the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. Use current supplied text; do not infer initial snapshots or comment order across the list. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_uses_analogy_to_familiar_scenario: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment itself draws an analogy, comparing the issue under debate to a different, familiar, everyday or commonly understood scenario (e.g., a common situation, activity or well-known comparison) to make its point. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so (literal discussion of the topic itself, or merely citing real examples of the same issue, is not an analogy). Quoted OP text alone does not count; the analogy must be the commenter's own argument. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution text, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither such an announcement nor an analogy by itself. Use current text; no timing is inferred. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Output a single 0/1 per row. (dtype: binary)

title_absolute_universal_quantifier: Read only the OP title. any_comment_quotes_op_text: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP), parsed as a list, together with the OP's title and argument as context. Return 1 if at least one comment contains a direct textual quotation (verbatim or near-verbatim reused wording, typically in quotation marks or block-quote markup) of wording that appears in the OP's title or argument. The quotation itself is what matters; the comment need not agree, disagree or refute. Paraphrase, mere topic mention, or quotes of third-party sources or of other commenters do not count. Match the quoted text against the supplied title/argument; if it matches, count it. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred: such text in the argument is neither a quote source nor evidence (generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible). Use current supplied text; do not reconstruct initial snapshots. Return 0 if the comment list is valid and non-empty but no comment quotes OP text, and 0 for a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing so that a negative cannot be established (a positive observed match to the available OP source is still 1). Output a single 0/1 value or null. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_acknowledges_op_validity_then_narrow_caveat: Read title and argument (OP context, to identify the target view) and OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments; parse it). Return 1 if at least one single comment first explicitly acknowledges that the OP's view or a point of it is valid/correct/reasonable (e.g. partial agreement stated in words) and then introduces a narrower, specific caveat, exception or qualification, in that order within that comment. Both parts must be in the same comment; separate comments cannot jointly satisfy it. Mere politeness or a bare 'but' without explicit acknowledgment does not count; a blanket rejection of the whole view does not count. Ignore OP text that announces a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and remains eligible. Ignore comment text quoting the OP only as background. Return 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment qualifies. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title/argument are missing so the target cannot be determined. List order carries no chronology or rank. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_immediate_blanket_contradiction: Read title and argument (OP context) and OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment opens by directly contradicting or rejecting the OP's view as a whole (a general, blanket disagreement, not limited to a narrow part) without first explicitly acknowledging any validity in the OP's view. Return 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment does this (including comments that acknowledge validity first or only raise narrow caveats). Ignore OP text that announces a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or title/argument are missing so the target cannot be determined. List order carries no chronology or rank. (dtype: binary)

post_creation_timestamp: Using df['post_created_utc']: return pd.to_numeric(df['post_created_utc'], errors='coerce'); missing or malformed values give null. Unit is Unix seconds; larger values are later within the dataset period. No text is read. (dtype: numeric)

any_comment_quotes_or_references_op_text: Read the OP title and argument (for context) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes (verbatim or near-verbatim, in quotation marks or block quote) or explicitly references a specific textual element of the OP's post (a particular sentence, phrase, claim, example or passage, e.g. 'you say that...', 'your point about X'), identifiable in the OP title or argument. Endorsement or refutation is not required; quoting is enough. Merely discussing the general topic without pointing to specific OP text does not count. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so. Return 0 if the list is a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if a negative cannot be established because the title/argument is missing (a positive match against available OP text is still 1). Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Marked edits in current text are otherwise usable. List order is not chronology or rank. Output one binary value. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_directly_quotes_op_post: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), parsing the list, and the OP's title and argument as the reference text. Return 1 if at least one comment directly quotes wording from the OP's title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim reproduced OP text, typically in quotation marks or block-quote formatting, that matches the available OP text). Endorsement is not required; the comment may agree, disagree or merely reproduce it. Paraphrase without reproduced wording, quotes of other sources/users, and quotations that do not match OP text do not count. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, in the argument or comments; such text is neither a quote source nor evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Use current supplied text, including marked edits, subject to that exclusion. Return 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment quotes OP text. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if OP title and argument are both missing (so a match cannot be established when no quote is observed). (dtype: binary)

any_comment_substantive_counterargument: Read title, argument (OP context to identify the OP's view) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment presents a substantive counterargument against the OP's view, i.e. gives reasons, evidence, or logic that challenge the OP's position (not mere disagreement, insults, jokes, questions without argument, or agreement). Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment does. Empty valid list: 0. Missing/malformed OC_comments, or missing OP title and argument: null. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and stays eligible. Use current text as supplied; list order carries no meaning. Output a single 0/1. (dtype: binary)

only_supportive_comments: Read title, argument (OP context to identify the OP's view) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users; parse it). Return 1 if the list has at least one comment and every comment expresses support or agreement with the OP's view, with no comment disagreeing with or challenging it. Return 0 if the valid list contains any comment that is not supportive (counterargument, disagreement, neutral or off-topic). Empty valid list: null (no comments to be supportive). Missing/malformed OC_comments or missing OP context: null. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Use current text as supplied; list order carries no meaning. Output a single 0/1. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_specific_counterargument_with_empirical_example: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), parsing the list; use title and argument only as context to identify the OP's view being countered. Return 1 if at least one comment makes a specific counter-argument to the OP's view that cites an empirical example, i.e. a concrete real-world case, documented instance, statistic/study finding, or specific personal experience offered as evidence (no outside verification required; examples are not limited to any type). Purely abstract, logical, normative or hypothetical/invented scenarios do not qualify; a vague generic assertion without a specific example does not qualify. The counter-argument and example must be in the same comment. Evaluate each comment on its own; list order has no meaning. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore and never use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if in argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Use current supplied text; do not infer initial snapshots or timing. (dtype: binary)

op_requests_emotional_support_or_assistance: Read only the argument column (the OP's own text; title not used). Return 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly asks readers for emotional support (e.g. comfort, reassurance, encouragement) or for assistance/help (e.g. help coping with or resolving a personal situation). Return 0 if there is no such explicit request, including when the OP only asks to have their view challenged or changed in the standard CMV way, or only describes feelings without asking for support or help. Exclude quoted text from others, moderator/bot notices, and any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if they thank people or mention support); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered. Use the supplied current text including marked edits; no initial snapshot is reconstructed. If argument is missing or malformed return null. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_concrete_external_analogy: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one comment introduces a concrete, external factual analogy: a specific actual real-world case, event, situation, or comparison from outside the OP's own scenario, used as an analogy or parallel to the topic (a concrete personal experience may qualify; endorsement of the analogy is not required). Purely invented hypotheticals, abstract principles, and pure logical reasoning without a concrete real-world case do not count. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty and no comment qualifies. Return 0 for a valid empty list? No: an empty list contains no analogy, so return 0. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. List order carries no meaning. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed if relevant. Judge from supplied current text only. (dtype: binary)

all_comments_solely_abstract_logical_refutation: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it). Return 1 if every comment relies solely on abstract logical refutation of the OP's view (general reasoning, principles, definitions, logical structure) and no comment introduces a concrete external factual analogy or specific real-world case/example. Return 0 if the list is nonempty and at least one comment introduces a concrete real-world analogy, case or example. Return null if the list is empty, missing or malformed. List order carries no meaning. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed if relevant. Judge from supplied current text only. (dtype: binary)

op_argument_word_count: Read only the argument column (OP's argument body; do not use title, comments or conversation). Count the words (whitespace-separated tokens) of the current supplied argument text, including marked edits and quotations, but EXCLUDING any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (e.g. 'CMV changed, delta awarded', 'thanks, you changed my view'). Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an announcement and stays counted. Do not try to reconstruct an initial snapshot; edits are otherwise counted as current text. Return a non-negative integer (units: words; 0 = empty text). If argument is missing or malformed return null. (dtype: numeric)
op_argument_exceeds_100_words: Using `op_argument_word_count`: return null if df['op_argument_word_count'] is null; return 1 if df['op_argument_word_count'] > 100, else 0. (dtype: binary)

op_argument_acknowledges_counterpoints: Read only the argument column (the OP's current argument text, including any marked edits). Return 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly acknowledges potential counterpoints, objections, counterarguments or opposing views to their own position (e.g. noting what others might object, or conceding a possible opposing consideration). Return 0 if no such explicit acknowledgment appears. Do not count quotations or opponents' positions that the OP does not themselves raise or adopt as a possible counterpoint, and do not count generic uncertainty without reference to a counterpoint. Exclude entirely, as evidence, any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed; such text must not produce a 1. Generic discussion of platform/delta rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible if it is relevant. Do not attempt to reconstruct an initial version of the post. If the argument is missing or malformed return null. Output 0 or 1 (or null). (dtype: binary)

supplied_log_length: Return pd.to_numeric(df['log_length'], errors='coerce') as the row value; null if missing or non-numeric. Observed range about 0.69 to 7.44. Construction, source text, log base and timing are undocumented; do not recompute or equate with word count. (dtype: numeric)

op_discloses_personal_emotional_vulnerability: Read only the OP's argument text (current supplied text, including marked edits). Return 1 if the OP, in their own voice, discloses personal emotional vulnerability about themselves, such as admitting their own fear, shame, insecurity, sadness, distress, loneliness, emotional pain or emotional struggle. Return 0 if there is no such disclosure: purely intellectual, factual or general statements, other people's feelings, hypothetical or invented persons, and quotations of others not adopted by the OP do not count. Mere anger or opinion without self-exposing vulnerability does not count. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (e.g., 'my view was changed', 'Delta awarded', 'thanks, you convinced me'), even if they express vulnerability; generic discussion of delta or platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be retained if relevant. Do not try to reconstruct an initial version of the post. If the argument is missing or malformed return null; if it is assessable and contains no qualifying disclosure return 0. Output a single 0/1 value. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_specific_empirical_evidence: Read OC_comments, a JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP. Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment itself contains specific empirical evidence in support of its argument: concrete statistics, data, named studies or sources, documented real-world cases, or specific factual observations/personal experiences (not merely general assertions, opinions, hypotheticals or invented scenarios). Verification against outside sources is not required. Evidence merely quoted from the OP as the OP's position does not count. Ignore any text announcing the OP's view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; do not use these as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and is not itself empirical evidence. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including an empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Output a single 0/1 or null. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_well_reasoned_counterargument: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it) and the OP's title and argument only to identify the OP's view being countered. Return 1 if at least one comment presents a well-reasoned counterargument against the OP's stated view, i.e. it directly challenges that view with coherent, relevant, logically structured reasoning or evidence. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so (including an empty list). Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or the OP title and argument are both missing. Ignore comment order. Do not use any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if embedded in the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is allowed where relevant. Do not use the conversation column. Output a single 0/1 or null. (dtype: binary)

any_comment_cites_numerical_data: Read OC_comments, a JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP. Parse the list. Return 1 if at least one comment itself asserts or cites specific numerical data or statistics (e.g. concrete figures, percentages, rates, counts, dates-as-quantities, study results with numbers) as part of its argument; the number need not be verified or from an outside source. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment contains such specific numerical data (only general assertions, qualitative claims, or incidental numbers not used as data, such as list numbering, 'two reasons', etc.). Ignore moderator/bot notices. Exclude any text that is an OP view-change or delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you or resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and may be retained, but is not numerical data evidence unless it is itself specific numerical data used in argument. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Output a single 0/1 per row. (dtype: binary)
